name: custom.deposits
description: Custom Deposits List Report with FCL
author: pgonzalezt

scripts.build:mta:bo: rimraf resources mta_archives && sed -i 's/ODATA_DESTINATION/BackOffice_Destination/g' xs-app.json && mbt build && git checkout -- xs-app.json
scripts.build:mta:cli: rimraf resources mta_archives && sed -i 's/ODATA_DESTINATION/Deposits_Destination/g' xs-app.json && mbt build && git checkout -- xs-app.json
scripts.deploy:bo: npm run build:mta:bo && cf deploy mta_archives/customdeposits_0.0.1.mtar
scripts.deploy:cli: npm run build:mta:cli && cf deploy mta_archives/customdeposits_0.0.1.mtar
